newsitem.title: USA: RTRS-Republicans poised to keep Senate majority-TV.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Republicans poised to keep Senate majority-TV.

text.p: Republicans were poised to hold majority control of the Senate, having won 15 of the 34 Senate races and were expected to hold on to enough other seats to have at least a 51-seat majority, according to television network projections.
"It looks like I will be majority leader of the Senate," Mississippi Republican Sen. Trent Lott said on the CNN television network.
Lott took over the Republican majority leader post in June with the resignation of Bob Dole to run for the presidency.
